question: 黑木耳的佣金比例是多少
sql: SELECT cr.rate FROM commission_rules cr JOIN products p ON p.id = cr.product_id WHERE p.name = '黑木耳'

question: 8月香菇抽成多少
sql: SELECT cr.rate FROM commission_rules cr JOIN products p ON p.id = cr.product_id WHERE p.name = '香菇' AND cr.effective_from <= '2026-08-31' AND (cr.effective_to IS NULL OR cr.effective_to >= '2026-08-01')
